# Forge

## Forge

- Kind: GitHub
- Host: github.com
- Repository: acme/app
- Remote: origin
- CLI: `gh`, version 2.99 or newer.
- Base branch: main; re-read with: `gh repo view github.com/acme/app --json defaultBranchRef --jq .defaultBranchRef.name`
- Merge style: squash; re-read with: `gh repo view github.com/acme/app --json mergeCommitAllowed,squashMergeAllowed`
